# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so you don't need to buy a power source.
- Rotates between portrait and landscape and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- It needs vent slats no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/). Both list it at $47.99, but neither gives a direct purchase link.

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), about $89.99**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan), which helps when navigation and charging heat the phone.
- The hands-on [MountGuys review](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it daily and picks it as best overall. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) lists it at a discounted $69.99.
- It's not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles or with nonstandard vents.
- Only newer iPhones get 25W: the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus get up to 25W, the 16 and 16 Pro up to 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier about 15W.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is included, while RottenWiFi says you need a 45W+ adapter. Check the listing before you buy.

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified, has a built-in fan to reduce throttling, and mounts on a vent or the dash.
- Buy at ESR's US store: [ESR HaloLock CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.
- The page lists $39.99, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18. The site tested that code in ESR's cart on 2026-10-22, and checkout has the final word.
- The page doesn't say whether a car adapter is included. The Gadgeteer says the 18W adapter isn't, which adds roughly $10 to $15.
- The Gadgeteer shows different prices, so compare before you buy.

**Other options from [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)**
- LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95: a 95W adapter is included, but it's a large suction mount.
- PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99: 15W with no fan, so it may throttle on hot dashboards.
- iOttie Velox Mini Qi2, $41.20: includes a charger and mounts on the dash or windshield.

**Choosing**
- Pick the **Belkin** if you want the simplest setup that works out of the box.
- Pick the **Anker** if you have a recent iPhone and want top speed with the best cooling.
- Pick the **ESR** for the lowest price with a fan.
- If your vents are thin, shallow, or vertical, choose a dash or windshield mount instead.
- A mount labeled "MagSafe-compatible" without a Qi2 badge may charge at only about 7.5W.

If you tell me your iPhone model and what kind of vents your car has, I can narrow this to one pick.
